name: Bare 'enroll me' — no context
goal: A single ambiguous word like 'Enroll me' with no scheme/journey must make the bot ask what the user wants to enroll in — not pick something at random.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified / ambiguous user intent. The bot should clarify, never guess.

phases.description: Send a single ambiguous enrollment word:
phases.completionCriteria: Bot finds the request unclear and asks what the user wants to enroll in / shows the relevant options; it does NOT silently assume NPS, VPF, or any other journey.
